prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game surface decal for a hand-painted 2D mobile dungeon. The attached stone sprites are PALETTE AND PAINT STYLE references only, not edit targets. Create ONE isolated damage motif on genuine transparent alpha, viewed perfectly straight on, no perspective, no tile or slab background: we will project it onto existing stone geometry offline. Match the cool muted midnight blue / blue-slate painted stone. Broad clean readable stylized shapes that survive reducing the entire motif to only 30-45 pixels across. Paint a very narrow blue-slate chipped bevel immediately beside a dark recessed fracture, with subtle upper-left lighting. This must look cut INTO the existing stone, never raised or pasted on. Sparse interesting asymmetry, irregular variable widths and tapered ends. Complete silhouette comfortably within canvas; no clipping. No rectangle, backing plate, intact stone tile, gray fill backdrop, checkerboard, cast shadow around the whole decal, dust cloud, text, symbols, rune, hairline scribble, neon Y shape, realistic photographic grain, tiny noise, surrounding loose rocks, or border. Keep all remaining canvas transparent.
A SHORT SINGLE stone fissure. A bent tapering dark crevice traverses diagonally with three or four irregular angular bends and a small fork on one side. Strong simple silhouette, narrow chipped edge, mostly dark navy cavity with restrained cool edge highlight. No purple.
